mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate weakening consumer demand and manufacturing activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1500 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market, signaling an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), a rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.0% and RSAFS rises, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
